subject: Follow-up: HealthWorks capacity discovery + next steps
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Chan <sylvia.chan@medisys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: HealthWorks capacity discovery + next steps

Hi Sylvia —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call so we’re all aligned and to make it easy for procurement/infra to move forward. Please correct anything I get wrong.

What we heard (pain & goals)
- Primary goal: Support inference for anonymized clinical note summarization and patient triage scoring at scale.
- Current bottleneck: on-prem GPUs are oversubscribed during peak clinical shifts (09:00–14:00 PST), leading to 300–500ms margin misses for 8k–12k daily concurrent requests.
- Isolation requirement: PHI data must remain within a HealthWorks VPC; you want dedicated, single-tenant capacity with audit logs and KMS integration.

Preliminary capacity ask (from our discovery notes)
- Reserved pool: ~6x A10G-equivalent GPUs to sustain steady-state throughput with 20% headroom.
- Burst/overflow: ability to burst ~+50% for scheduled seasonal loads (quarterly results windows).
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile < 200ms for short prompts (<=512 tokens); target p50 < 80ms.

Next steps I’m proposing
1) I attached a short capacity estimate (HealthWorks_capacity_estimate_v1.xlsx) that maps your QPS profile to GPU counts and projected monthly spend. Please share with procurement.
2) Dev/infra sync: Dev, can you confirm whether HealthWorks can accept a cross-account VPC peering model or if an on-prem appliance is required? If KMS/HSM details are needed, I’ll pull in our security lead.
3) Compliance artifacts: attaching a short SOC2 evidence summary you asked about; we can expand this into a scannable bundle for your audit team.
4) Scheduling: propose a technical deep-dive next Tuesday (2026-03-10) to walk configs and SLO testing approach.

Open questions for you
- Would procurement prefer a 12-month reserved commitment or a 3-month pilot with credit-based conversion to reserved?
- Any blackout windows where bursts must be guaranteed?

Thanks — I’ll update the HubSpot deal with the capacity numbers and drop the Drive link for the files.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: HealthWorks_capacity_estimate_v1.xlsx, redwood_soc2_evidence_summary.pdf
From: Sylvia Chan <sylvia.chan@medisys.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medisys.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: HealthWorks capacity discovery + next steps

Thanks, Diego — this is very helpful and accurate. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The clinical note summarization workload will initially hit the service with bursts around 11:30–13:30 PST tied to shift changes; those are the critical windows.
- We prefer a 3-month pilot to validate SLA and cost before committing to annual reserved capacity. If pilot results meet our SLOs we’ll move to a 12-month reservation.
- Isolation: VPC peering is acceptable; however, we need the option to route some payloads through our on-prem gateway for a subset of endpoints (legal/consent flow). Can your team support a hybrid routing policy?

Procurement asked for an itemized price for pilot (monthly) and an estimated 12-month reserved rate; please include any startup/onboarding fees and SLA credits. Also include a short statement on data residency and log retention.

We can do the technical deep-dive on 2026-03-10 at 10:00 AM PST. Please send a calendar invite.

—Sylvia
VP Product, HealthWorks AI
Sylvia.Chan@medisys.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up: HealthWorks capacity discovery + next steps

Marissa / Dev — forwarding Sylvia's confirmation and procurement asks. Action items: 

- Marissa: can you draft a 3-month pilot commercial term and an annual reserved option with clear SLA credits? Include onboarding fees and a line for integration support hours. Use deal id HW-2026-03.
- Dev: please validate hybrid routing options (VPC peering + on-prem gateway) and whether we need a small edge appliance to meet the routing requirement. Also confirm KMS/HSM integration notes for the SOC2 bundle.
- I’ll schedule the 2026-03-10 technical deep-dive and attach the capacity spreadsheet in the invite.

Keeping this tight since procurement is moving fast.

Thanks,
Diego
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
